observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the right margin and the locators «p. 148.» (L8) and «p. 149.» (L37) in the left margin. The 3 of the line number 35 is printed broken.
body L40-L42: the words from «eamque» to «differentiam» are italic.

notes_right L3: the full stop at the end of the note is printed low, under the baseline.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
